name: shadcn/vue
description: Vue port of shadcn/ui: copy-paste Tailwind components built on Reka UI that you own and restyle; pick it for Vue/Nuxt sites that want shadcn look and full code control.
setup_notes: Needs Tailwind CSS (Vite: npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite) and an @/ path alias; Nuxt: also run npx nuxi@latest module add shadcn-nuxt. Components are copied into components/ui.

name: Reka UI
description: Unstyled, accessible Vue primitives (formerly Radix Vue); pick it when you want full styling control with correct ARIA and keyboard behaviour.
setup_notes: Headless: bring your own CSS/Tailwind. Optional auto-import via unplugin-vue-components resolver; Nuxt module available.

name: Nuxt UI
description: Official Nuxt component library (125+ Tailwind components incl. page/hero/pricing sections) built on Reka UI; pick it for Nuxt or Vite+Vue sites that want polished defaults fast.
setup_notes: Nuxt: modules: ['@nuxt/ui'] and in main CSS @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@nuxt/ui"; wrap app in <UApp>. Vue/Vite: add ui() from '@nuxt/ui/vite' to plugins and app.use(ui) from '@nuxt/ui/vue-plugin'. Components are auto-imported with U prefix.

name: PrimeVue
description: Large Vue component suite (DataTable, DatePicker, Galleria...) with design-token themes; pick it for data-heavy apps. v5+ is under the PrimeUI dual licence.
setup_notes: import PrimeVue from 'primevue/config'; import Aura from '@primeuix/themes/aura'; app.use(PrimeVue, { theme: { preset: Aura } }). v5+ PrimeUI License: free Community licence only for eligible individuals/small orgs (<$1M revenue, <5 devs), otherwise paid Commercial; releases before v5 stay MIT.

name: Ark UI (Vue)
description: Headless, state-machine driven (Zag.js) Vue components with many complex widgets (date picker, carousel, combobox); pick it for accessible custom-styled Vue UIs.
setup_notes: Unstyled; import each component from its subpath (e.g. '@ark-ui/vue/dialog').

name: Ark UI (Svelte)
description: Headless, state-machine driven (Zag.js) Svelte components; pick it for accessible custom-styled Svelte UIs needing complex widgets.
setup_notes: Unstyled; import each component from its subpath (e.g. '@ark-ui/svelte/dialog'); overlays use Portal from '@ark-ui/svelte/portal'.

name: Inspira UI
tags: animated|motion|aceternity vue|magic ui vue|hero effects|backgrounds|text animation|landing page|showpiece
description: Copy-paste animated Vue/Nuxt components (Aceternity/Magic UI ports: aurora backgrounds, text reveals, marquees, 3D cards); pick it for showpiece motion on Vue landing pages.
setup_notes: Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn-vue CLI set up (npx shadcn-vue@latest init) because components are added from https://registry.inspira-ui.com/<name>.json into components/ui. Respect prefers-reduced-motion yourself.

name: shadcn-svelte
description: Svelte port of shadcn/ui: copy-paste Tailwind components built on Bits UI; pick it for SvelteKit sites that want shadcn look with owned code.
setup_notes: Needs Tailwind (e.g. npx sv create my-app --add tailwindcss). Components are copied into $lib/components/ui. Svelte 5.

name: Bits UI
description: Headless accessible component primitives for Svelte 5; pick it when you want your own styling on solid a11y foundations.
setup_notes: Svelte 5 only. Unstyled; style via classes/data attributes.

name: Melt UI (next-gen)
description: Next-generation Melt UI: headless builders and components for Svelte 5; pick it for low-level control when Bits UI is too opinionated.
setup_notes: Svelte 5.0+, Node 18+. Pre-1.0 (0.x) API may change; import builders from 'melt/builders' or components from 'melt/components'. The older @melt-ui/svelte package is the Svelte 4-era API.

name: Skeleton
description: Tailwind-based design system with themed Svelte components (built on Zag.js); pick it for SvelteKit sites that want themes out of the box.
setup_notes: Svelte 5, SvelteKit 2, Tailwind 4. In global CSS: @import 'tailwindcss'; @import '@skeletonlabs/skeleton'; @import '@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte'; @import '@skeletonlabs/skeleton/themes/cerberus'; then <html data-theme="cerberus">.

name: Angular Material
description: Official Material Design component library for Angular; pick it for Angular apps that accept Material styling.
setup_notes: ng add installs Material + CDK and configures a theme, typography and animations.

name: Angular CDK
description: Angular Component Dev Kit: unstyled behaviour primitives (overlay, dialog, a11y, drag-drop); pick it to build custom-styled Angular components.
setup_notes: Unstyled; for overlays include the prebuilt overlay CSS (@angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css).

name: spartan/ui
description: shadcn-style UI for Angular: accessible 'brain' primitives on npm plus copy-in 'helm' Tailwind styles; pick it for Angular sites wanting the shadcn look.
setup_notes: Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and @angular/cdk. Add components with ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui <name>; helm imports like '@spartan-ng/helm/dialog' resolve to code generated into your repo.

name: Web Awesome
tags: web components|custom elements|shoelace|framework agnostic|no build|cdn|html components
description: Successor to Shoelace: framework-agnostic web components (<wa-*>) with themes; pick it for plain HTML/Astro sites or any stack needing accessible widgets without a framework.
setup_notes: import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/styles/webawesome.css'; then cherry-pick components (e.g. import '@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/dialog/dialog.js'). CDN loader alternative: https://ka-f.webawesome.com/webawesome@3.14.0/webawesome.loader.js. Core is free; optional paid Pro tier.

name: daisyUI
tags: tailwind plugin|component classes|themes|css only|no js|btn|modal|framework agnostic
description: Tailwind CSS plugin adding semantic component classes (btn, modal, tabs, carousel) and themes; pick it for fast styled markup on any stack.
setup_notes: Tailwind CSS v4: in your CSS @import "tailwindcss"; @plugin "daisyui";. CSS-only: interactive behaviour relies on native <dialog>/<details>/popover or your JS.

name: Pico CSS
description: Minimal semantic CSS framework that styles plain HTML elements (optionally class-less); pick it for simple content sites and prototypes.
setup_notes: CDN: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@picocss/pico@2/css/pico.min.css">. No JavaScript included (you script dialogs yourself).

name: Open Props
description: 500+ CSS custom properties (colors, sizes, easings, shadows, keyframe animations); pick it for token-driven CSS and ready-made easing curves.
setup_notes: CSS: @import "open-props/style"; or CDN <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/open-props"/>. Animations like var(--animation-fade-in) and easings like var(--ease-bounce-2).

name: Floating UI (DOM)
description: Low-level positioning engine for tooltips, popovers and dropdowns in vanilla JS; pick it when building custom floating elements without a UI kit.
setup_notes: Positioning only: you handle ARIA, focus and dismissal.

name: Floating UI (Vue)
description: Vue bindings (useFloating composable) for Floating UI positioning; pick it for custom Vue tooltips/popovers.
setup_notes: Positioning only: you handle ARIA, focus and dismissal.

name: Embla Carousel
description: Lightweight dependency-free headless carousel with swipe; pick it for custom-styled sliders (used under shadcn carousels).
setup_notes: Vue: npm install embla-carousel-vue --save; Svelte: npm install embla-carousel-svelte --save. Needs CSS: viewport overflow hidden, container display flex, slide flex 0 0 100%. npm latest is v8 (API scrollPrev/scrollNext); docs site shows v9 (goToPrev/goToNext) - check the version you install.

name: Swiper
description: Full-featured touch slider with built-in effects (fade, cube, coverflow), autoplay and pagination; pick it for feature-rich carousels.
setup_notes: Import modules you need from 'swiper/modules' and their CSS (swiper/css, swiper/css/navigation, ...).

name: Splide
description: Lightweight, accessibility-minded slider/carousel in vanilla JS; pick it when carousel a11y matters.
setup_notes: Import a theme CSS: '@splidejs/splide/css' (or /css/core). Give the root an aria-label.

name: PhotoSwipe
description: Image lightbox/gallery with zoom and swipe gestures; pick it for portfolio and product image galleries.
setup_notes: Every item needs data-pswp-width and data-pswp-height; import 'photoswipe/style.css'.

name: Cally
description: Tiny accessible calendar web components (<calendar-date>, <calendar-range>) to compose date pickers on any stack.
setup_notes: Pre-1.0 (0.x). Only calendar grids: pair with an input + popover yourself. CDN: <script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/cally"></script>.

name: Lucide
description: Clean, consistent stroke icon set (1,500+) with per-framework packages; the default pick for UI icons.
setup_notes: Framework packages: lucide-react, @lucide/vue, @lucide/svelte, @lucide/angular (old lucide-vue-next / lucide-svelte / lucide-angular are deprecated).

name: Phosphor Icons
description: Flexible icon family in six weights (thin to duotone); pick it when you need weight variety for expressive UI.
setup_notes: Vue: npm install @phosphor-icons/vue; Svelte: npm install --save-dev phosphor-svelte. Web package is an icon font per weight.

name: Tabler Icons
description: Very large (5,000+) free stroke icon set with Vue/Svelte components and a webfont.
setup_notes: Vue: npm install @tabler/icons-vue; Svelte: npm install @tabler/icons-svelte.

name: Iconify
tags: icons|200000 icons|all icon sets|mdi|web component|on demand
description: Unified access to 200k+ icons from 150+ sets via one component or web component, loaded on demand; pick it when you need icons from many sets.
setup_notes: Web component works in any stack (import 'iconify-icon'); Vue: npm install --save-dev @iconify/vue; Svelte: npm install --save-dev @iconify/svelte. Loads icon data from the Iconify API at runtime unless bundled. Licences vary per icon set.

name: Heroicons
description: Tailwind Labs' SVG icon set (outline 24, solid 24, mini 20, micro 16); pick it for Tailwind-styled React/Vue sites.
setup_notes: React: npm install @heroicons/react. Import paths encode size/style: /24/outline, /24/solid, /20/solid, /16/solid.

name: Recharts
tags: charts|react charts|svg charts|line chart|bar chart|area chart|pie chart|composable
description: Composable SVG charting components for React; the common pick for dashboards in React/Next.
setup_notes: Peer deps: react, react-dom, react-is. Client component in Next.js App Router.

name: Chart.js
description: Popular canvas-based charting library with smooth built-in animations; pick it for simple, lightweight charts on any stack.
setup_notes: import Chart from 'chart.js/auto' registers everything (no tree-shaking); register individual controllers/scales for smaller bundles. Canvas: add an accessible fallback/aria-label.

name: Apache ECharts
description: Powerful charting library for large, interactive datasets (maps, heatmaps, sankey); pick it for data-dense dashboards.
setup_notes: Use tree-shakeable imports from 'echarts/core' with an explicit CanvasRenderer or SVGRenderer. Vue wrapper: npm install echarts vue-echarts.

name: Observable Plot
description: Concise grammar-of-graphics charting from the D3 team returning plain SVG elements; pick it for editorial/data-story charts.
setup_notes: Plot.plot() returns a detached SVG/figure element: append it to the DOM yourself (in frameworks, inside a mounted effect).

name: Unovis
description: Modular data-visualization library with native Vue and Svelte (and React/Angular) components; used under shadcn-vue charts.
setup_notes: Svelte: npm install -P @unovis/ts @unovis/svelte.
